cases.name: release
cases.reason: Released split permits retirement/resplit; consuming Before returns exact bound; final owner Drop returns original scratch.

cases.name: live_split
cases.reason: Any live writer/reader/flusher view prevents exclusive retirement.

cases.name: consumed_owner
cases.reason: The old bound is moved into the operational result, including failure ownership.

cases.name: live_reservation
cases.reason: The exact linear reservation keeps its operational owner exclusively borrowed.

cases.name: workspace
cases.reason: Consuming conversion retains the original scratch loan.

cases.name: load_release
cases.reason: Released views allow actual selected load and subsequent resplit.

cases.name: load_split
cases.reason: Live reader/writer/flusher views prevent exclusive load.

cases.name: load_permit
cases.reason: Code outside storage cannot name or mint the private Status load permit; field-level minting is not claimed by this probe.
